title: GlobalDomesticMinimumGroupEntityTaxReturnResponse
description: This is the response for the Combined Global and Domestic Minimum Group Entity Tax Return when successfully submitted.

GlobalDomesticGroupEntityForm.description: This is the response data for a successfully submitted Group Entity Combined Global and Domestic Tax Return

message.description: Response message to let the lodger know their lodgment was successful.

date.description: Timestamp for when the lodgement was completed.

entityName.description: The name of the group entity which form was lodged for.

australianBusinessNumber.description: This is the ABN of the group entity and will be returned if applicable for the group entity.

paymentAmount.description: This is the total amount of liabilities the group entity has to pay.

paymentReferenceNumber.description: This is the payment reference number for this group entity. Will be returned if there is an amount to be paid.
